queries.result: Found the City of Arlington, Texas Maps Online reference and first-party ArcGIS REST services. The OpenData OD_Property MapServer documents a Tax Parcel polygon layer and the city plat-search page directs users to Maps Online for parcel identification.

queries.result: No distinct Spanish-language Arlington cadastral portal was found in the discovery results; the official City of Arlington English Maps Online and ArcGIS parcel service were the relevant first-party results. The service was then tested directly without translation or coordinate modification.
